description: This file defines an interface for counting connection metrics, including methods to record success and failure events, retrieve metric type, and reset counters. It serves as a helper for metrics collection within a messaging connectivity context.

classes.name: ConnectionMetricsCounter
classes.description: Interface for a metrics counter specifically related to connection events, facilitating success/failure recording, metric type retrieval, and reset functionality.

methods.name: getMetricType
methods.description: Returns the metric type associated with this counter.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the metrics counter to its initial state.
